summary: This project is a website with an integrated SI/AI model built in. This project is broken up into 4 different sections. It is made for both professionals as well as student to provide an easy to use simulation application and AI chatbot. The AI is trained on all 26 of NASA's publicly available PSI experiments as well as the various historical aerospace events that took place from combustion accidents. The AI model is able to take input data such as standard telemetry, processing and simulating that information based on background knowledge in order to provide the user with a response on whether the condition is nominal or not, and how to fix issues that may be present, working step by step. The website also allows you to look at historical data and experiments, allowing you to learn from them. Lastly the website also allows the user to view various variable relationships in both text and visual form.
details: The project is an interactive website, it allows users to input data into simulation, understand relationships, and get answers on various conditions within a spacecraft. It allows users to view information on combustion easily and allows user to simulate problems to understand what should be done in those situations. The project is made to increase the safety of space flight missions by reducing the chances of a combustion related mishap. Google Antigravity, Google Gemini, HuggingFace, HTML, Javascript, Google AI Studio, Claude, ChatGPT, Typescript. Our project is different because it allows users to input their own data and compare it to experimental/historical data and also allows users to simulate various conditions without needing large hardware.
